description:
Requirement for a two-row flame weeder with 250 wgal tank (200 gallon propane capacity).

Specifications:

  • Capable of treating two rows of crops with 30-inch row spacings.
  • Must have hoods designed to operate fully closed for shorter crops or partially open for taller crops.
  • Capable of mounting on a tractor with a 3-point hitch.
  • Total width must be no wider than 8 feet 6 inches for transport on public roads.
  • Propane tank capacity of 200 gallons.
  • Fully-fueled weight less than 2,500 pounds to allow for use with most tractors currently in inventory.
